record.title: ModularAdmin
record.description: Bootstrap 4 admin with jQuery: dashboard, items list and editor, charts (Flot, Morris), forms, tables, buttons, icons, auth and error pages.

license.notes: Pinned to the gh-pages branch (built site, 2019-07-15), which has no LICENSE file; MIT read from LICENSE on master at fb247f5a373b (2019-07-14, the build's source period). Bundles jqvmap (MIT/GPL dual), Flot (MIT), Morris (BSD) and Quill 1 (BSD-3).
